methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: for real-time power measurement and which would be used for generating Linked Open Data

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents an IoT power-measurement device (EnBoX = Arduino + non-invasive current sensor computing P = V x I) and a semantic-web Linked Open Data architecture for real-time Life Cycle Inventory data collection. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised: no normalisation/relevant variables, no functional form, no baseline-construction approach. The energy link is to LCA (ISO 14040/14044), not to ISO 50001/50006 energy performance.

paper_type.evidence_quote: here we present the development of an energy measurement device

stage1.notes: Device name 'Energy Baseline of X (EnBoX)' is branding for a current-sensor power meter (P=V*I), not an ISO 50006 energy baseline; no EnPI or normalisation. Tool/data-architecture paper. Case study is injection moulding (discrete manufacturing), so level_3b is false on sector grounds too. Human flag: the 'Energy Baseline' name could trip a keyword FN detector.
